units.source_text: 这个时候，有一家名叫丸佐的古董商劝说父亲卖掉雏人偶。

en.t: Around this time, an antique dealer called Marusa urged my father to sell the hina dolls.

units.source_text: 不过，如今这家的老板也已经去世了，那是一个头有点秃、样子极为滑稽的人。

en.t: By now, however, the owner of that shop has also passed away; he was a rather comical-looking man with a slightly bald head.

units.source_text: 他脑袋顶中间有一块刺青，就像贴着一快臭臭的狗皮膏药一样。

en.t: In the middle of the top of his head he had a tattoo, as if a smelly dogskin plaster had been stuck there.

units.source_text: 听老板自己说，这是他年轻的时候为了遮掩微秃的头顶，

en.t: According to the owner himself, when he was young he had it done to hide the slight bald spot on top of his head,

units.source_text: 专门请人刺上去的，只是没想到后来自己的整个后脑门都秃光了，

en.t: having specially asked someone to tattoo it there, only never expecting that later the whole back of his head would go completely bald,

units.source_text: 只剩下了脑门上这块刺青。

en.t: leaving only this tattoo on his forehead.

units.source_text: 那个时候，我只有十五岁，尽管丸佐老板数次劝说，父亲最后都拒绝卖掉雏人偶。

en.t: At that time I was only fifteen, and although the owner of Marusa urged him several times, my father refused in the end to sell the hina dolls.
